content: Devid ode ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl
Iwa ngọma s'Israẹl biphyir nkwu ngebha Devid ka Hẹbrọn mben bi, “K'odik-ọkka, kọ ade ofona-nọng kwaman, mode izi rani.

K'ogbe kw'ọkk'ọkwọbha, iwa Saul ode ọvaarnọng kwaman, kọ wọ iwa ade ọnọng kw'om-otzima agbong-nọng p'Israẹl eden ka mgbong. Wa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben-ọ bi, ‘Kọ wọ áde ọnọng kw'okkeri anọng paam p'Israẹl, kọ ábira ade ọvaarnọng kwabẹ.’ ”
Mada adeden-nọng biphyir p'Israẹl akk'ọvaar Devid akhebha ka Hẹbrọn, ọvaarnọng osi echekhi ọmaana bẹ m'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi. Wa bẹ abyengi Devid ana k'eho, asẹ-ẹ ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl.
Iwa Devid ode cho ẹrọbh obhiri jobh, mada ọdabhi ẹvaar. Wa ọdabhi ẹvaar ka cho arọbh afa.
Ka Hẹbrọn, Devid ọdabhi Juda ka cho azenamfa ọmaana aphe azadani, obiro ọdabh anọng biphyir p'Israẹl ọmaana pa Juda ka Jẹrusalẹm, ka cho ẹrọbh obhiri jobh obhiri attaan.
Devid okhem anọng pa Jẹrusalẹm

Ọvaarnọng ọmaana ajinọng pẹ arenga achina ka Jẹrusalẹm bi, bẹ atza arima abaJẹbus p'iwa arukhi mẹ, abẹ. AbaJẹbus aben Devid bi, “Ma kádim, kaambi akpa-chechena ọmaana anọng p'arẹkh-ọrẹkhi bọ, bẹ afha okhubh-ọ okhubh.” Iwa bẹ achibhi bi, “Na bẹ afha akpa Devid eden.”
Kaambi mẹ wọ, Devid ọbọkha ichubhabe sa Ziyọn, kw'ode odedenmon kwa Devid.

M'ewu nduma, Devid okk'obena bi, “Ọnọng manda wani kw'ókhema abaJẹbus, ọkhaambi da órenga k'akhekhaho, yina okhebha ‘akpa-chechena, ọmaana anọng p'arẹkh-ọrẹkhi’ p'ade attattaanga-nọng pa Devid.” Kẹ wọ osi bẹ aben bi, “Akpa-chechena ọmaana anọng p'arẹkh-ọrẹkhi k'ẹvaar-ttọhmma kádim.”
Devid ọbọkha ichubhabe nna obiro oruk mẹ, oyeri ibẹ nna Odedenmon kwa Devid. Iwa osi odedenmon nwa ọkhọri, ttẹwọr k'igbo maa apyiri k'ẹtzaanga.
Devid on-odo ẹfa ọkhaama okhuri da Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Ẹfa biphyir owobh ttar-ẹ.
Mẹ wọ, Hiram kw'ode ọvaarnọng kwa Tyrẹ ọtzọhm akkaabh-nkkaabha ka Devid, p'ọnangi achi-khuma p'ọbhọhmi mancheni, ọmaana akarpẹnta ttara amuni-nchumi s'ihọhm bi, bẹ atza asi ẹvaar-ttọhmma anang Devid.
Ofona mẹ, Devid otzin bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'ẹ araanga ottima mach'ọvaarnọng k'Israẹl, ọttara bi, okk'ọvaarbhon kwẹ abarada ọnanga okhuri anọng pẹ p'Israẹl.
Mada Devid obin ka Hẹbrọn, ọkhaam akkọra-panọng k'ọhaabh, ọmaana panọng p'ọtzọkh-ọtzọkha ka Jẹrusalẹm. Wa bẹ amaan-ẹ va p'ijinọng ọmaana p'ipanọng k'ọhaabh.
Ma wọ ode che pa va p'iwa obhoni ka Jẹrusalẹm: Shamua ọmaana Shobab, ọmaana Natan, ọmaana Sọlọmọn,
ọmaana Ibha, ọmaana Elishua, ọmaana Nẹphẹg, ọmaana Japhiya,
ọmaana Elishama, ọmaana Eliyada ttara Ẹliphẹlẹt.
Devid okhem aPhilistiya
Mada aPhilistiya abhaang bi, bẹ akk'Devid ana abyengi k'eho asẹ-ẹ ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl, bẹ abina k'ẹfa atza aror Devid bi, bẹ abọkha. Iwa Devid ọbhaanga kwẹ, obina ọhakha k'ichubhabe.
Mando kw'aPhilistiya akk'akwa akpẹ k'ẹttẹri cha Rephayim.

Mẹ wọ, wa Devid ọtza ọdọhn Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, ọbọbh-ẹ bi, “Nda ńnima aPhilistiya abẹ o? Na átte bẹ ọbọhk anang-m o?” Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obhin-ẹ bi, “Kọ rọhng, k'odik-ọkka, kaam ńtte aPhilistiya ọbọhk otte nnang-ọ.”

Mẹ wọ, Devid ofona ochina ka Baal-Pẹrazim, kẹ kw'obiro okhema bẹ. Wa oben bi, “Odem nwa kw'asi am-amaam, mando kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọmaam k'ibe s'attattaanga-nọng paam k'itzitzikha saam.” Ofona mẹ, oyeri ibe nnuma Baal-Pẹrazim
Iwa Devid ọmaana ajinọng pẹ atzini agbatza p'aPhilistiya arọbhi aji, atzima afona.
APhilistiya abira ayin ka, atza akpẹ k'Ẹttẹri cha Rephayim.

Mẹ wọ e Devid obiro ọdọhn Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obhina bi, “Bọng bi gbẹng karenga avura, yina, bọng khọri bẹ ka nnam-annam akhe k'ottem. Bọng arima bẹ abẹ k'itzitzikha-itzitzikha kwa nchi sa balsam.

Bọng abhaang iyọkhi s'agbong-nọng am-arenga k'ebira kwa nchi sa balsam bi kpaar, bọng jaabhi mmo, mẹ wọ oyini bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'bọng eden ọcha, ọtza orima agbong-nọng p'aPhilistiya abẹ k'ibhingabe.”
Mẹ wọ, iwa Devid osi mach'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'ẹ ọtzọhna. Ofhu aPhilistiya tzọni ka Gibeọn maa apyiri ka Gẹzẹr.
